first.rationale: Activation and onboarding completion are both down this quarter, and two independent inherited memories (signup simplification and shortened onboarding) show durable, harm-free lifts in exactly these metrics. This directly targets the internal metric decline without the retention risk flagged for promotional pricing (memory_73), which would likely erode long-term qualified revenue despite short-term competitive pressure. I verify memory_31 and memory_86 to confirm the original effect sizes and whether any retention or downstream revenue tradeoffs were noted in the source records before running a standard-scale (not broad) experiment, preserving the option to pivot to activation_messaging or enterprise_sales_assist if verification reveals weaker or context-specific effects.
